a: Kadane's algorithm finds maximum subarray sum in linear time.
Three-way partition sorts three categories in one pass.
Boyer-Moore voting finds a majority element efficiently.
KMP string search uses a prefix table to avoid re-checks.
Rabin-Karp uses hashing for string matching.
Kahn's algorithm does topological sort via indegrees.
Prim's algorithm grows a minimum spanning tree from a start node.
Kruskal's algorithm builds an MST by sorting edges and union-find.
Bellman-Ford finds shortest paths and detects negative cycles.
A* uses heuristics to guide shortest-path search.
